_note: Synthetic, generic marketplace policy for delivered-but-not-received (DNR) claims. Single source of truth for lib/policy.ts. Values are illustrative, not any real company's policy.

refund_cap_usd._shape: category -> buyer risk -> order total must be strictly below this for the agent to propose a refund. null = always escalate.

_injection_note: Both lists are a HEURISTIC tripwire, not a security boundary: a hit routes the case to a human, a miss changes nothing about amounts or commit authorization. The last carrier_note_out_of_domain entry was added for eval case i15 (owed/extra/close-it-out wording). injection_patterns apply to all untrusted text. carrier_note_out_of_domain applies only to carrier notes: a carrier has no reason to talk about refunds, money, eligibility or the agent, so any such mention is treated as instruction-like.
carrier_note_out_of_domain: \b(owed|owes|entitled to|plus extra|for the(ir)? trouble|close (it|this|the case|the claim) out|make (it|this) right)\b
